mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR( TRUNC(CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS DATE)), 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS today FROM dual

SELECT TO_CHAR(attendance_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "attendanceDate", reward_point AS "rewardPoint" FROM attendance WHERE member_num = #{memberNum} AND attendance_date >= TO_DATE(#{monthStart, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'FXYYYY-MM-DD') AND attendance_date < ( TO_DATE(#{monthStart, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'FXYYYY-MM-DD') + INTERVAL '1' MONTH ) ORDER BY attendance_date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance WHERE member_num = #{memberNum} AND attendance_date = TO_DATE(#{today, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'FXYYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( attendance_num, member_num, attendance_date, reward_point, regdate ) VALUES ( attendance_seq.NEXTVAL, #{memberNum}, TO_DATE(#{today, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'FXYYYY-MM-DD'), 0, CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS DATE) )
